newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Chinese Bank FRCD raised to US$80 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Chinese Bank FRCD raised to US$80 mln.

text.p: Hong Kong Chinese Bank's five-year floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been closed with the amount increased to US$80 million from US$50 million, the arrangers said.
The certificates were priced at par to float at 60 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate. There are put and call options in years three and four.
With fees, the all-in return for top tier managers is 75 basis points.
Arrangers are Schroders Asia, Bank Austria Hongkong, Bayerische Landesbank Hongkong, Jardine Fleming Bank, Kwangtung Provincial Bank Hongkong and KEB Asia Finance.
Some six other banks have joined the syndication.
Hong Kong Chinese Bank is 50 percent held by HKCB Bank Holdings and 50 percent held by China Resources Holdings.
